entities.name: James
entities.description: One of the two friends in this conversation, a programmer and lifelong gamer who tried programming once in college and now works with Python and C++. He owns the dogs Max, Daisy and Ned, supports Liverpool, travels (Italy, Turkey, Mexico, Canada and Nuuk), learned the drums in March 2022, took up extreme sports and cooking in 2022, started streaming games in September 2022, released his first game by October 2022, and began a relationship with Samantha in September 2022. He and John have known each other since they were about ten.

entities.name: John
entities.description: The other friend in this conversation. He began a programming class in March 2022, did HTML and CSS years earlier, took freelance work, volunteered his coding for a charity, left an IT job of three years in mid-2022 for a new job, and turned towards organising esports tournaments and mentoring game developers. He plays CS:GO, took up chess in July 2022 and won a regional tournament in November 2022, collects books, detects metal on beaches, teaches his siblings and parents to code, and has no pet although he wants one.

entities.name: Samantha
entities.description: The woman James met at a beach dog outing on 9 August 2022; she gave him her number, became his girlfriend on 3 September 2022 at the theatre, loves the theatre and a good lager, and by 31 October 2022 she and James had rented an apartment together near McGee's bar.

entities.name: Jill
entities.description: Someone close to John, referred to by James as "your Jill"; James brought her a souvenir from his July 2022 trip alongside John's.

entities.name: James's sister
entities.description: James's sister, never named in the conversation. She visited him on 21 July 2022, spent the day with him and his dogs, and was by the ocean with him to watch a sunset. James says he is blessed with a close bond with her and that they are like a family.

entities.name: James's mother
entities.description: James's mother, never named. She visited him on 19 October 2022 with an army friend; the two of them used to tell James stories about their time in the military and about their dog, and their old Nintendo console was the first James played on.

entities.name: the army friend of James's mother
entities.description: An unnamed woman who came with James's mother to visit him on 19 October 2022. On 21 October 2022 James said both that she is still serving and that she retired a long time ago. She and James's mother told him military stories and owned the old gaming console he played on as a child.

entities.name: Josh
entities.description: A friend of James, visited together with Mark during the family road trip that began on 4 November 2022.

entities.name: Mark
entities.description: A friend of James, visited together with Josh during the family road trip that began on 4 November 2022; James and his family stopped at an animal sanctuary on the way to them.

entities.name: John's younger siblings
entities.description: John's younger siblings, never named and always spoken of together. They live far from him, threw him an all-night gaming marathon when he was younger, joined the same programming course he did, worked with him on a text-based adventure game and by September 2022 were writing their own small games and stories.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: One of James's dogs, a shepherd and one of the two he had from the start alongside Daisy. Lovable and playful, a strong swimmer who plays in the water at the beach or the lake, never misses a frisbee in mid-air, and walks with James on the trail near his house.

entities.name: Daisy
entities.description: One of James's dogs, a Labrador who loves playing with her toys and loves eating most of all. She does tricks, waits for treats, and lies next to James while he games.

entities.name: Ned
entities.description: The puppy James adopted from a shelter in Stamford in the week before 12 April 2022, a shepherd and his third dog. He was introduced to Max and Daisy on 17 June 2022, went to the clinic for a check-up and vaccination on 5 August 2022, and James says he cannot imagine life without him.

entities.name: Luna
entities.description: The dog belonging to John's cousin, shown to James on 7 November 2022.

entities.name: Italy
entities.description: A country James visited in 2021 and called beautiful with delicious food; one of the first three countries he had been to.

entities.name: Turkey
entities.description: One of the three countries James had visited as of April 2022, alongside Italy and Mexico.

entities.name: Mexico
entities.description: One of the three countries James had visited as of April 2022, alongside Italy and Turkey.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: The last country John had visited as of April 2022. He was impressed by its technologically advanced megacities, the huge screens on the buildings and the street food.

entities.name: Canada
entities.description: The fourth country James visited, in July 2022, flying to Toronto on 11 July 2022 and also planning Vancouver.

entities.name: Toronto
entities.description: The Canadian city James bought air tickets to, leaving on the evening of 11 July 2022.

entities.name: Vancouver
entities.description: The second Canadian city James planned to visit on his July 2022 trip.

entities.name: Nuuk
entities.description: A city James also reached during his July 2022 trip; he stayed only briefly but counted it as one more country on his list, his fifth.

entities.name: Stamford
entities.description: The place where the shelter James adopted the puppy Ned from is located, in the week before 12 April 2022.

entities.name: McGee's pub
entities.description: The pub James proposed instead of Starbucks for his 27 August 2022 meeting with John, known for a good stout and also serving light beers. James and Samantha drink there, and by 31 October 2022 they had rented an apartment nearby partly because of it.

entities.name: the trail near James's house
entities.description: An unnamed trail about a mile from James's house where he takes Max and his other dogs for long walks; he also speaks of it as the park he goes to alone with a book. He calls it tranquil and says it helps him think straight and find inner peace.

entities.name: John's programming course
entities.description: The programming class John signed up for on 17 March 2022 to refresh the HTML and CSS he had learned years before. He met three new friends there on 19 April 2022, and his younger siblings later joined the same course.

entities.name: James's gaming and programming course
entities.description: A course combining gaming and programming that James started shortly before 13 June 2022. His class worked on a new part of a football simulator, for which James built the player databases; he chose it mainly to improve himself.

entities.name: James's cooking class
entities.description: The cooking class James signed up for on 2 September 2022 at $10 a lesson. In the first lesson the class made several simple dishes, a meringue and dough, and James was pleased with his omelette.

entities.name: the chess club John joined
entities.description: The chess club John joined after taking up chess in July 2022, where he practises against others alongside playing online.

entities.name: the online programming group John joined
entities.description: An online group of skilled coders passionate about using technology for good, which John joined on 19 August 2022. He shared ideas, exchanged contacts and worked with one member on a project, though he called that a one-off.

entities.name: James's gaming group
entities.description: The group of friends James plays with regularly, communicating by voice chat during matches, streaming their sessions and meeting up in person; he also hosted an all-night gaming marathon with them.

entities.name: Liverpool
entities.description: The football club James supports. He says there is no club better, does not miss a match, and hoped they would be champions the following season; he and John bet on whether Liverpool or Manchester City would finish higher.

entities.name: Manchester City
entities.description: The football club John supports. James said they were in bad form with a terrible transfer policy; John answered that their manager could handle it and bet they would finish above Liverpool.

entities.name: the charitable foundation John built a tool for
entities.description: An unnamed charitable foundation whose passion is helping children. It kept paper records and counted inventory by hand until John volunteered his programming and built it a smartphone application in May 2022.

entities.name: the organisation James volunteers with
entities.description: An unnamed organisation that provides necessary items to people who are less fortunate. James volunteered with it in May 2022 and offered on 19 June 2022 to take John there the following weekend and introduce him to the staff; no interview is required.

entities.name: the game development non-profit
entities.description: A non-profit for game developers that emailed John by 3 October 2022 offering him a volunteer position as a programming mentor, teaching coding and assisting with projects.

entities.name: The Witcher 3
entities.description: James's favourite game in March 2022, praised for its story and atmosphere. It inspired the virtual world he built with a gaming friend on 14 April 2022 and, he says, his own first game. John had not played it in March 2022 and was hooked on it by August 2022.

entities.name: CS:GO
entities.description: John's favourite game. He played it in a tournament at a gaming convention in March 2022, organised a charity tournament for it on 7 May 2022, and wants to organise state-level competitions for it.

entities.name: Apex Legends
entities.description: James's favourite game as of April 2022, played with his team and praised for its graphics and fast-paced gameplay. Also one of the games played at John's charity tournament on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: Civilization
entities.description: The turn-based strategy series James played for a month up to April 2022 — identified by John as Civilization VI — in which you manage resources, lead armies and conquer territories. It is the game he wanted to model his own strategy game on.

entities.name: Total War
entities.description: A strategy series James names alongside Civilization as what he had always loved playing and what led him to build a strategy game of his own.

entities.name: Cyberpunk 2077
entities.description: A game John had played and recommended to James on 3 October 2022 for its immersive world and story. James tried it on 20 October 2022 and found it addictive; John warned him that dialogue choices can be life-changing.

entities.name: Fortnite
entities.description: A game John said in August 2022 he could host competitions for, and one of the games played at his charity tournament for a children's hospital on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: Overwatch
entities.description: One of the games played at John's charity gaming tournament on 30 October 2022.

entities.name: FIFA 23
entities.description: The football game John was hooked on in November 2022, playable online against players worldwide. James said he would train on it so the two could play together.

entities.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
entities.description: The game John was playing at the end of April 2022; James called it awesome.

entities.name: Super Mario
entities.description: One of the two games James played for hours as a child on his mother and her friend's Nintendo console, and which sparked his passion for gaming.

entities.name: The Legend of Zelda
entities.description: A game James played for hours as a child on the old Nintendo console, and the 2D adventure he compared John's first mobile game to in September 2022.

entities.name: Dungeons of the Dragon
entities.description: The board game John tried in the week before 18 September 2022 and called very exciting; it is what got him into board games.

entities.name: The Name of the Wind
entities.description: The novel John recommended to James on 29 April 2022 for its writing; James had never heard of it and said he would check out the trilogy.

entities.name: Kingkiller Chronicle
entities.description: One of John's two favourite book series, named on 16 June 2022 alongside The Stormlight Archive.

entities.name: The Stormlight Archive
entities.description: One of John's two favourite book series, named on 16 June 2022 alongside the Kingkiller Chronicle; he loves the magical worlds and characters that feel real.

entities.name: The Expanse
entities.description: The science-fiction series John recommended to James on 16 June 2022, calling it epic.

entities.name: the game development magazine
entities.description: An unnamed magazine for game developers, full of tutorials, developer interviews and tips. James recommended it to John on 20 September 2022 and found John already read it; both call it a useful resource.

entities.name: John's coding blog
entities.description: The blog about coding John started in the week before 16 June 2022. He calls it exciting and a little scary, a way to share his coding journey, track his progress and connect with other coders.

entities.name: James's first game
entities.description: The computer game James has wanted to make since he was a child, grown out of the comics he drew and the sketches he made of its main character; he set out to combine gaming and storytelling in it and offered John HTML work on it. Joined here with the first game he had made and released to the gaming community by 13 October 2022, which he says The Witcher 3 inspired. Kept apart from the big project he finished in April 2022, because a first release six months later cannot be that same finished game.

entities.name: James's big project
entities.description: The project James spoke of on 4 May 2022 as one he had been working on for weeks and on 23 May 2022 as a big project of months that he had just finished. A bug in its code broke its game mechanics on 29 April 2022 and a group of friends helped him fix it; finishing it meant learning a new language and taught him problem-solving, patience and perseverance. The two mentions are joined because their dates and details line up.

entities.name: the virtual world inspired by The Witcher 3
entities.description: A virtual world James built with one of his gaming friends on 14 April 2022, combining programming and gaming. He had no screenshot of the whole world but did have one of the character he created for it, whose face came from a stranger he passed while walking his dogs.

entities.name: James's Unity strategy game
entities.description: The strategy game James built in Unity, wished for on 26 August 2022 and finished by 1 September 2022. He modelled it on Civilization and Total War; the hard part was balancing the mechanics and keeping it fair, and he credits feedback, collaboration and John's encouragement.

entities.name: the dog walking and pet care app
entities.description: The mobile application James proposed on 17 March 2022 after John suggested they build something together: an app connecting pet owners with reliable dog walkers and offering pet care information, set apart by letting each owner record their dog's own preferences and needs.

entities.name: the website for a local small business
entities.description: John's first professional project outside his class, taken on as freelance work in April 2022. Progress was slow with hiccups, and the hardest part was getting payments working on the site.

entities.name: the inventory application for the charitable foundation
entities.description: The software tool John volunteered to build for a charitable foundation before 11 May 2022. It replaced paper records and manual inventory with one smartphone application that tracks inventory, resources and donations and generates reports.

entities.name: John's first mobile game
entities.description: A 2D adventure game with puzzles and exploration, John's first mobile game and what he called a major career milestone by 20 September 2022, due to launch the following month. He worked on it secretly for months, built its puzzles with the help of a game-design book, and James offered to test it.

entities.name: the online board game
entities.description: An online board game John created with a game developer over the weekend of 5-6 November 2022; a demo was about to be released for feedback and James promised to try it.

entities.name: the coding project John does with his siblings
entities.description: A simple text-based adventure game John built together with his younger siblings from August 2022 to teach them to code; by September 2022 they were writing their own small games and stories.

entities.name: John's portable smoker startup
entities.description: A startup making portable smokers that John began on 19 September 2022, welding the first one himself out of metal.

entities.name: video gaming
entities.description: The pursuit James and John share and the ground of their friendship. James says it motivates him, is a shared language and a refuge in tough times; John says it helps him relax and escape stress. Both play, compete, organise tournaments and build games.

entities.name: programming
entities.description: The other pursuit the two share. James tried it in college and says it became his life, working in Python and C++; John refreshed HTML and CSS on a course from March 2022, freelanced, blogged, volunteered his coding, taught his siblings and parents and became a mentor.

entities.name: bowling
entities.description: A game James loves, having got two strikes on 16 March 2022. John cannot share it: he says his fingers are too big and that he does not like bowling.

entities.name: VR gaming
entities.description: Virtual reality gaming, which both men had tried separately and found strikingly immersive; on 17 March 2022 they agreed to try it together on Saturday 19 March 2022.

entities.name: metal detecting
entities.description: John's hobby from March 2022: he bought a metal detector and walks the beaches with it. His finds have been mostly bottle caps, but also a couple of coins and once a gold ring.

entities.name: playing the drums
entities.description: James took up the drums a few days before 27 March 2022 and practised daily. John said on the same day that he had been playing for a month and had his own kit; on 18 September 2022 he instead said he used to play when he was younger and had not played in a while, so the conversation disagrees with itself about him.

entities.name: chess
entities.description: John took up chess on or about 22 July 2022 to sharpen his strategy, playing mostly online and in a club. James, who had played before, advised studying openings and analysing games; John won the regional chess tournament on 1 November 2022.

entities.name: skateboarding
entities.description: What James and John were into when they were about ten: they went to the skate park with a group of friends, helped each other learn tricks and sometimes left class early for it. James still rides occasionally and has taught his dogs to balance on a board.

entities.name: reading
entities.description: How John relaxes: he is a fan of science fiction and epic fantasy, bought enough books to nearly fill his bookcase by June 2022. James also loves reading, bought an illustrated fantasy adventure book on 26 April 2022 and takes a book to the park.

entities.name: cooking
entities.description: A hobby James took up on 2 September 2022 despite never having liked cooking, wanting to learn something new. He made an omelette, a meringue and dough in his first class and hopes to cook for John.

entities.name: extreme sports
entities.description: What James turned to in mid-2022 to take breaks from his hobbies: rope jumping on 8 July 2022 from a height of 150 metres, and surfing on 6 July 2022, which he found relaxing.

entities.name: travelling
entities.description: Something both men love. James had been to Italy, Turkey and Mexico by April 2022, Canada in July 2022 and Nuuk on the same trip; John had last been to Japan and says travel and rest are what motivate him to work. They agreed in April 2022 to try to travel somewhere together the following year.

entities.name: streaming games
entities.description: Something James's gaming group does with their sessions and which James started himself by 18 September 2022; his stream on the night of 19 September 2022 drew kind comments from the community and inspired him to continue.

entities.name: football
entities.description: James loves football, says no sport is better, supports Liverpool and does not miss a match; his course worked on a football simulator. John supports Manchester City, and the two bet on which club would finish higher.

entities.name: board games
entities.description: John played a strategy board game with friends on 27 April 2022 and got properly into board games in September 2022 with Dungeons of the Dragon; he also created an online board game with a developer in November 2022.

entities.name: John's gaming setup
entities.description: A gaming PC with a powerful graphics card, a headset, a gaming chair and keyboard like James's, on a desk he refurbished in August 2022 with new devices and wall lighting. He added Sennheiser headphones and a Logitech mouse before 4 September 2022.

entities.name: James's gaming setup
entities.description: The cutting-edge gaming system James bought before 27 March 2022 for its graphics: a gaming PC, keyboard, mouse and a comfortable chair, with a new video card added in the week before 3 October 2022.

entities.name: James's notebook
entities.description: The notebook James writes in. In March 2022 he said he wrote all his goals in it and found checking them off satisfying; by 18 September 2022 he said he had started writing down everything he needed to do so as not to forget, and he also sketched his castle dream in it.

entities.name: the old Nintendo console
entities.description: The Nintendo console belonging to James's mother and her army friend, James's first gaming system. He played Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda on it for hours as a child, and it sparked his passion for gaming; he still has a photo of himself playing on it.

claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The tournament John played at the March 2022 gaming convention was for CS:GO, his favourite game, and watching the skilled players compete inspired him to improve his own gaming.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John says he is always looking to up his game and hit new goals, and that the same commitment runs through his hobbies and everything else.

claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James lost in the final rounds of the 3 April 2022 tournament, but said it was close, that he enjoyed competing against talented players and that he was looking forward to the next one.

claims.speaker: James

claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The advice James remembers most from the players he met is that you must always communicate properly with your team and never put your ego above team success.
claims.speaker: James

claims.speaker: James

claims.speaker: James

claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John kept his first mobile game secret while he made it because he would have been very upset to have announced it and then have it not work out; he had been working on it for the previous few months.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James likes 2D adventure games with puzzles such as The Legend of Zelda and offered to help test John's mobile game; John said he would let him know when testing was ready.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John used a book full of tips and insights on game design to create the puzzles in his first mobile game, and also watches tutorials and follows developer forums to keep learning.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James recommended a game development magazine to John on 20 September 2022 and found John already read it; both say its tutorials, developer interviews and tips have helped their game development skills.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James said the week to 20 September 2022 had been good for him and was mostly about finding a balance between work and other activities.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John said the week to 20 September 2022 had been chaotic but that he was powering through, and he accepted James's advice to make time for himself and recharge.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John went from saying on 17 March 2022 that he had not played The Witcher 3 but meant to, to being hooked on it by 10 August 2022.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: By 3 October 2022 John had been emailed about a volunteer position at a game development non-profit, something he had wanted to do for a while and saw as the perfect start to a career combining gaming and helping people.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The game development non-profit asked John to be a programming mentor for game developers, teaching coding and assisting with their projects.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said mentoring game developers was a great chance to help them and to boost his own skills, that he loves seeing others reach their potential, and that he hoped it would open more opportunities.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: In the week before 3 October 2022 James got a new video card and was excited to get back into gaming with it.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James is very into RPGs, and on 3 October 2022 he asked John whether Cyberpunk 2077 was worth his attention on the new video card.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John had played Cyberpunk 2077 and recommended it to James for its immersive world and amazing story.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: In the week before 13 October 2022 John and his programmer friends organised an online competition where everyone showed off their skills, which he had a blast running.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: By 13 October 2022 James had made his first game and released it to the gaming community, and found it fulfilling to see players engaging with the world he had created and enjoying what he had put so much work into.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James says The Witcher 3 gave him a great deal of the inspiration for his first game, its world and story pushing him to create something of his own.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: After releasing his first game James said the effort had paid off and that he was ready to make more games in different genres and test out new ideas.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James thanked John on 13 October 2022 for always having his back, and John said they make a good team and that James can count on him for anything.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 18 October 2022 James's apartment lost power just as he reached the big reveal in the game he was playing, and he had to wait hours before he could play again.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The power cut of 18 October 2022 cost James some of his game progress because he had forgotten to save, and he resolved to save more often.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: In the week before 21 October 2022 John organised a programming seminar that had a great turnout, and he found sharing his knowledge and seeing the group benefit fulfilling.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: From his programming seminar John gained insight into various programming approaches and techniques and found it interesting to hear other developers' ideas and strategies, some of which he can use in his own work.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As of 21 October 2022 John had not yet tried out the new programming techniques from the seminar, but was looking forward to experimenting with them.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John promised to send James resources and tutorials on the new programming approaches and techniques he had learned at the seminar.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 19 October 2022 James's mother came to see him with her army friend and they had fun together.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 21 October 2022 James said of his mother's army friend both that she is still serving and that she retired a long time ago.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James's mother and her army friend used to tell him stories about their time in the military and about their dog.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James has a photo of himself as a child playing the game Mario on his mother and her friend's old Nintendo console, whose gamepad he and John both found funny.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: The Nintendo was the first gaming system James had: as a child he played Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda on it for hours, and he says it sparked the passion for gaming he has had ever since.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 20 October 2022 James tried Cyberpunk 2077 and called it a great and addictive game.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John told James that the hardest thing in Cyberpunk 2077 is making the right choices, because even the choice of dialogue lines can be life-changing, and that he need not be friends with every character — without spoiling it.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On the night of 30 October 2022 John held a gaming tournament with his buddies, playing Fortnite among other games, and they raised a decent amount for a children's hospital.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: At the charity tournament of 30 October 2022 John and his gaming friends also played Overwatch and Apex Legends, and he says everyone was competitive and had a blast raising money for the hospital.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John photographed the charity tournament of 30 October 2022 and called it an awesome and unforgettable moment for everyone there.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: By 31 October 2022 James and Samantha had decided to move in together, which James said was a mutual and informed decision.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James and Samantha rented an apartment not far from McGee's bar, and James admits that having that particular bar nearby was one of their criteria for choosing it.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John wished James and Samantha luck with the move on 31 October 2022 and asked to be kept posted.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On 4 November 2022 James and his family set off on a road trip with his dogs, exploring new places and taking in nature.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On Tuesday 1 November 2022 John won the regional chess tournament, which he found intense; he said his hard work and practice had paid off and it gave him a huge confidence boost.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's strategy in the regional chess tournament was to analyse and anticipate his opponent's moves so as to stay one step ahead.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John credits studying opening moves, learning from experienced players, analysing past games and the chess advice James gave him in July 2022 for his improvement, and he shared a resource on chess openings with James.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: As of 5 November 2022 John was hooked on FIFA 23, a football game that can be played online against players all over the world.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James decided to try the sports genre with FIFA 23 and to practise first so that he and John could play together, John telling him all he needed was a gamepad and a sense of timing.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: On 7 November 2022 James and his family were still on their road trip and had already visited his friends Josh and Mark, with whom they had a great time.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: Over the weekend of 5 and 6 November 2022 John worked with a game developer on a project and found it incredible to see his own ideas come to life.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: What John and the game developer created over the weekend of 5 and 6 November 2022 was an online board game.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John said a demo of the online board game was about to be released so others could try it and give feedback, and James promised to try it and share his thoughts.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: On the way to visit Mark and Josh during the November 2022 road trip, James and his family visited an animal sanctuary full of rescue dogs, which made him think of his and John's love of furry pals.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James wanted to take the rescue dogs at the sanctuary home but remembered that he already has three dogs, and says that more than three would be too many.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John said on 7 November 2022 that he still had not got a dog but still really wants one.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: James says having his dogs around brings so much joy and friendship that life would not be the same without them, that they make even dark days better and are his best buddies.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John says dogs bring joy and positivity every day and accept people without judgement, and that he appreciates the daily dose of positivity they bring to his life.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The dog belonging to John's cousin is called Luna, and James said it was a great name.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John ended the conversation of 7 November 2022 early, apologising as he went.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: John's programming went from signing up for a class on 17 March 2022, through freelance work on a small-business website in April 2022 and a tool he volunteered for a charitable foundation in May 2022, to being asked to mentor game developers for a non-profit by October 2022.
claims.speaker: John

claims.text: The game James described on 17 March 2022 as one he had wanted to make since he was a child became, by 13 October 2022, his first game released to the gaming community.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: James and Samantha went from meeting at a beach dog outing on 9 August 2022, to her becoming his girlfriend at the theatre on 3 September 2022, to the two of them deciding by 31 October 2022 to move in together into an apartment near McGee's bar.
claims.speaker: James

claims.text: John took up chess on 22 July 2022 to sharpen his strategy, joined a chess club, and by 1 November 2022 had won the regional chess tournament.
claims.speaker: John
